name: Deinstedt (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Deinstedt (a yellow yoke and a wheel on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Deinstedt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Deinstedt arms — yoke and wheel on blue
